title: Remote Dispatcher / DSR — Plumbing & HVAC Service Coordination (ServiceTitan)
description:
Employment type: Full-time, long-term

Hours: [40 hrs/week] — must cover Canadian business hours, Mountain Time (MST/MDT). Roughly 7:30AM MST - 4:30PM MST. Same schedule every week; this role requires being reachable in real time during the workday.

Salary: $1000 CAD/month, paid [bi-weekly/monthly]. Performance bonuses tied to schedule efficiency and conversion.

Location: Remote (work from home)





About High Point



High Point Plumbing & Heating is a Canadian home-services company built on Pure Motive Service — being a window that shows customers every honest solution, never a door that stands in the way. The CSR works hard to book the call; the Dispatcher makes sure the right Technician walks through that window. We have detailed manuals and a full training program, and we'll teach you our exact systems. We want someone to own this role and grow with us for the long haul.



The Role



The Dispatcher (DSR) is the air-traffic controller of our service day. You know where every Technician is at all times, you assign calls by priority and skill so each customer gets the best possible outcome, and you keep the whole schedule moving. You dispatch to the opportunity — matching the right Tech to the right call — and you live by Zero Tolerance for Turndown: no customer gets left behind a closed door.





What You'll Do



Track all Technicians throughout the day and keep the dispatch board current in ServiceTitan

Dispatch calls in the right order: priority ? technician skill ? area ? time

Maintain constant real-time communication with Technicians via phone and Slack

Send complete call details to Techs (customer info, history, problem, special instructions, PO numbers)

Monitor progress and make delay/reschedule calls early — by the midpoint of the time window, never letting a customer wonder if we forgot them

Enforce Zero Tolerance for Turndown: flag every dispatch-fee-only/no-sale call and coordinate a supervisor or QC tech to revisit the options

Coordinate parts and Purchase Orders with the Warehouse Manager to keep Techs productive

Manage call completion, follow-ups, recalls, and after-hours/emergency scheduling per priority rules

Verify technician timecards (ServiceTitan / Fleet Pro), run end-of-day closeout, and prep next-day first calls

Run the daily check-in meetings (9:30 AM / 11:00 AM / 2:00 PM) with the CSR and Service Manager

Keep Technicians on track calmly and professionally, using caring "coaching one-liners" — never arguing





Must-Haves (Please don't apply without these)



Hands-on ServiceTitan experience (real daily use, ideally including dispatch/scheduling and Fleet Pro)

HVAC and/or plumbing trade background — you understand call priority, urgency, parts, and terminology

Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, calm communication with Technicians and customers

Sales / conversion mindset — you grasp why dispatching to the opportunity and Zero Tolerance for Turndown drive revenue, not just logistics

Strong multitasking, calm under pressure, and obsessive about following up

Reliable high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and backup power/internet





Nice-to-Haves



Prior dispatching experience for a North American home-services / trades company

Experience coordinating field technicians and managing a live schedule





How to Apply (read carefully — this is how we screen)



Start your application with the word "DISPATCH-MVP" so we know you read the whole post.

Tell us in 3–4 sentences about your ServiceTitan/dispatch experience and your plumbing/HVAC background.

Briefly describe how you'd handle this: It's 3:30 PM, a Technician is running an hour behind on a job, and you have two more customers waiting in his afternoon window. Walk us through your next steps.

Attach a 60-second voice recording in English so we can hear your phone presence.





Applications without the voice sample and the scenario answer will not be reviewed. We're excited to meet our next Service MVP.

title: Virtual Assistant: Student Support & Social Media Response
description:
IMPORTANT: This is an availability-based role, not a full time workload position. You are required to be available and responsive during your shift, but actual active work varies week to week depending on content performance and student volume. There is significant downtime. You are being paid for your availability and responsiveness. Please read the full description before applying.



**About us:**

We run LeadsEngine, a SaaS and education platform that teaches people how to start a local medical supply acquisition business. We have an active student community and a growing social media presence across TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube.



**The role:**

We need a reliable, responsive VA to be our first point of contact across our student
 community and social media platforms. The work itself is not complicated, but responsiveness is everything. When a message comes in, we expect a reply within minutes. If you are someone who needs to be reminded to check your phone, this is not the right fit.



**What you'll do:**

- Monitor and respond to student questions in our
 community. Students ask about product pricing, condition, and whether certain items are worth buying. We provide a full pricing sheet and workflow document. You need to know it well.

- Respond to DMs and comments on TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube using a provided script, directing prospects to our landing page

- Monitor and respond to our landing page live chat via Tawk.to. One to two questions maximum per visitor. Anyone with more questions gets directed to book a discovery call.



**You're a great fit if you:**

- Write clear, friendly, professional English (non-negotiable)

- Respond to messages immediately when they come in, every time

- Are comfortable staying logged into multiple platforms and responding across all of them throughout your shift

- Have experience managing social media responses or community support

- Are dependable, organized, and don't need to be chased



**Details:**

- Monday through Saturday, 12pm to 10pm US Eastern Standard Time

- This is an availability-based role. There is significant downtime but you must be switched on and ready to respond the 
nt a message arrives. Volume on, notifications enabled at all times during your shift.

- Some weeks are very busy, others are light depending on content performance and student volume. Pay is consistent either way.

- Rate: $75/week

- Scripts, workflows, and a full pricing reference guide are provided

- Long-term position for the right person



**How to apply:**

1. Send a short intro about yourself and your experience managing community or social media responses

2. Describe a time you had to manage multiple platforms or inboxes at once

3. Start your reply with the word ENGINE so we know you read this fully

title: B2B Lead Generation VA — List Building + Cold Email for IT Reseller (SMB Focus)
description:
I work in sales for a US-based IT reseller, and I'm looking for a sharp, detail-oriented lead generation VA to help me build my outbound pipeline from the ground up.



We sell IT solutions — hardware, software, licensing, firewalls, networking, SaaS — at transparent, competitive pricing. My approach is simple and honest: I give prospects a real shot to lower what they're paying. Your job is to help me reach the right people and start those conversations.



A big part of this role is SOURCING the leads. You'll research and build targeted contact lists of purchasing and IT decision-makers — using tools I provide (like Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator) plus your own careful research — then run a weekly cold
 campaign and hand me the warm replies to quote.



We're focused on small and mid-sized US businesses, where there's usually a single decision-maker (an IT manager or owner) who can act fast on a good quote. This is an ongoing role — I want a long-term working relationship and reward good work with raises.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Source and build targeted contact lists in Apollo and LinkedIn (filter by job title, company size, industry, location)

- Target purchasing/procurement and IT decision-makers: IT Manager, IT Director, Purchasing/Procurement Manager, owner/operator at SMBs

- Verify the right person and a valid business
 before sending, using LinkedIn and company websites

- Load lists into a cold
 tool (Instantly / Smartlead) and run a weekly campaign from a sending domain I provide

- Monitor replies — filter out no-thanks, out-of-office, and bounces; flag the genuinely interested

- Log each warm lead in a shared Google Sheet/CRM (name, company, what they're sourcing, their reply) and notify me to quote

- Keep lists clean — remove anyone who replies or opts out



I provide all the tools, the sending domain, and the data subscriptions. You don't need to bring your own contact lists — I want someone skilled at sourcing and verifying leads with proper tools, not someone selling a pre-built database.



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Strong written English

- Hands-on experience with Apollo.io (or similar: ZoomInfo, Lusha, Clay)

- Experience running cold
 campaigns (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Mailshake, etc.)

- Comfortable with LinkedIn research / Sales Navigator

- Google Sheets / basic CRM (HubSpot a plus)

- Honest and detail-oriented about data quality



NICE TO HAVE

-
 deliverability know-how (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, inbox warmup)

- Prior experience selling into US businesses

- Familiarity with IT/tech products



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word "TRANSPARENT" so I know you read the full post.

2. Tell me which lead-gen and cold
 tools you've used, and for how long.

3. Quick test: Pick any real mid-sized US company. Walk me through the exact steps and tools you'd use to find and verify the business
 of their IT Manager or Purchasing contact.

4. One sentence on the largest contact list you've built and its bounce/reply rate, if you know it.



Applications that don't start with "TRANSPARENT" or that skip the test won't be considered. I read every qualifying application personally.

THE ROLE

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

to work with AI, not just at AI.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

title: Remote Bookkeeper + Customer Support Specialist
description:
We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems.



This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why.



What You'll Do

Daily (the core of the job):

*Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks

*Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received

*Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage)

*Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off

*Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances



Weekly:

*Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends

*Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner

Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts



As needed:

*Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up

*Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations



What We're Looking For

Required:

*Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking)

*Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables

*Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.)

*Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it

*Clear English communication, written and spoken

*Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report



Bonus points for:

*Retail or perishable inventory experience

*Bookkeeping for a US-based small business

*Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling)



What This Job Is Not

*It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily.

*It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible.

*It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure.



How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?"

2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count.

3. A short note with:

*Your years of QuickBooks experience

*Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability

*One sentence on why this role fits you right now



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: CONTROLLER
description:
Recruit + Field is a premium qualitative market research recruiting firm. We recruit, screen, qualify, and place respondents — and we hold ourselves to a very high standard in everything we do. We're looking for a Controller who brings that same standard to our finances.



This is not a passive reporting role. We need someone who is genuinely invested in the financial health of this company — someone who reads the numbers, understands what they mean, asks hard questions, and flags issues before they become problems. You will have real visibility into the business and direct access to leadership.



The ideal candidate is equally comfortable processing an invoice and presenting a financial dashboard to leadership. You execute AP and AR personally, you watch the numbers closely, and you speak up when something is off. This is a do-it-yourself role with real organizational impact.



You will own the full financial operations cycle — including personally executing AP and AR transactions daily, month-end close, payroll coordination, reconciliations, and reporting — while also serving as the company's internal watchdog on spending, vendor costs, and financial accuracy. This role is equally about execution and oversight. You are in the weeds and watching the big picture at the same time.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



We are growing, and our financial infrastructure needs to keep pace. We need a single point of ownership for financial operations — someone who proactively monitors spending, holds vendors accountable, surfaces risks, and ensures that leadership always has an accurate, current picture of the company's financial health.



The right person will bring order, visibility, and vigilance to our finances and become a trusted partner to leadership.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Financial Vigilance & Expense Oversight

This is a top priority, not a secondary task. You will actively monitor company finances and flag anomalies proactively.

• Conduct regular expense audits — reviewing all company spend across QuickBooks, Ramp (corporate card platform), and vendor invoices

• Identify unusual charges, duplicate billing, unauthorized spend, or cost creep and escalate immediately to leadership

• Maintain and regularly review a vendor master list; flag redundant, lapsed, or overpriced vendor relationships

• Review all invoices before payment to verify accuracy, proper coding, and business justification

• Proactively surface cash flow risks, budget variances, and unusual trends — don't wait to be asked

• Build and maintain a recurring audit cadence (monthly and quarterly) for all expense categories



2. Accounts Payable & Receivable — Full Execution

This is a hands-on execution role, not a supervisory one. You will personally process AP and AR transactions daily — this is a core part of the job, not a delegation task.

Accounts Payable

• Review, code, and process all incoming vendor invoices — verifying accuracy, proper GL coding, and business justification before any payment is made

• Execute vendor payments including check runs, ACH transfers, and credit card settlements — ensuring nothing is paid late or paid incorrectly

• Manage all non-autopay items in QuickBooks Online from receipt through to cleared payment

• Advance payments when due and proactively manage payment timing to maintain vendor relationships and avoid late fees

• Collect W-9 / W-8 forms from all new vendors before first payment is issued; maintain vendor records accurately in QuickBooks Online

• Reconcile vendor statements against QuickBooks records and resolve discrepancies directly with vendors

• Oversee 1099 preparation and filing at year-end, including respondent 1099 reporting in coordination with the ops team

Accounts Receivable

• Generate and send client invoices accurately and on time — ensuring invoices match agreed project scopes and terms

• Record and apply all incoming payments in QuickBooks Online promptly and accurately

• Monitor outstanding receivables and proactively follow up on any past-due balances — escalating to leadership when needed

• Maintain clean AR aging — flag any overdue accounts or collection risks early

• Reconcile client payments against invoices and resolve any billing discrepancies directly with clients or internal project leads

• Keep bank feeds updated and ensure all transactions are assigned consistent, accurate accounting codes



3. Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

• Execute month-end close — reconciliations, journal entries, bank/credit card statement reconciliations

• Prepare monthly financial package: P&L, cash flow summary, balance sheet snapshot, and budget vs. actuals

• Generate dashboard-ready reports for leadership that are clear, accurate, and actionable — not just data dumps

• Attend and contribute to monthly financial review meetings; own follow-up action items

• Review weekly accounting accuracy and resolve variances promptly



4. Payroll Coordination

• Oversee payroll processing in coordination with the payroll processor (Human Resources) and QuickBooks Online payroll

• Manage benefits coordination, department/role changes, and new hire payroll setup

• Ensure payroll accuracy and flag discrepancies before they are processed



5. Quarterly Financial Management

• Conduct comprehensive reviews of budgets, forecasts, and profitability metrics

• Lead quarterly vendor contract reviews to identify savings opportunities

• Prepare quarterly financial statements and present clear, actionable insights to leadership

• Ensure compliance with quarterly tax filing requirements; liaise with external CPA as needed

• Run scenario analyses, burn reports, and cash flow projections as needed



6. Process Improvement & Documentation

• Identify inefficiencies in financial and operational workflows and implement practical improvements

• Document and maintain SOPs for all key financial processes

• Leverage tools — QuickBooks Online, Ramp, and others — to their full capability

• Partner with Sales, HR, and Operations to ensure financial processes support business goals



7. Financial Support to the VP of Qualitative Research & CEO

While this role reports directly to the VP of Qualitative Research, the Controller also serves as a financial resource to the CEO — providing visibility, analysis, and insights that support company-level decision-making.

• Keep the VP of Qualitative Research informed with accurate, timely financial summaries and flag anything requiring attention or escalation

• Provide the CEO with financial data, reporting, and analysis as needed — including profitability summaries, cash flow snapshots, and budget vs. actuals

• Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and scenario models as requested by the VP or CEO

• Attend leadership meetings as needed and contribute clear financial context — translating numbers into plain language

• Proactively surface financial trends, risks, or opportunities to leadership rather than waiting to be asked

• Support budget planning, goal-setting, and financial forecasting in partnership with the VP and CEO



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first 90 days, a successful Controller will:

• Have fully taken over AP and AR — all invoices processed, payments advanced, and client invoices going out cleanly and on time

• Complete a full audit of current vendor spend and surface any flags to leadership

• Establish a clean, consistent month-end close process

• Deliver a financial dashboard that leadership can actually use

• Have caught at least one thing that wasn't being caught before



Ongoing, you will be measured on financial accuracy, the timeliness and quality of reporting, the proactiveness of your issue-flagging, and your genuine partnership with the VP of Qualitative Research and CEO.



CORE COMPETENCIES



• Financial stewardship — you treat company money with care and take personal ownership of financial health

• Proactive communication — you surface issues early, not after the fact

• Attention to detail — you notice things others miss

• Technical proficiency — advanced QuickBooks Online; experience with Ramp or similar expense platforms

• Analytical thinking — you understand what numbers mean, not just what they say

• Process discipline — you build systems that prevent problems, not just respond to them

• Cross-functional collaboration — you work well with non-finance people and translate financial data clearly



SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS



Education

• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or a related field (required)



Experience

• Minimum 7 years of experience in a controller or senior accounting role

• Minimum 2 years working cross-functionally with non-finance teams

• Demonstrated experience with expense auditing, vendor management, and financial controls

• Experience in a small business or startup environment strongly preferred — you are comfortable being the only finance person in the room



Technical Requirements

• Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (non-negotiable)

• Experience with corporate card/expense platforms (Ramp experience a plus)

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for reporting and analysis

• Comfortable with remote tools and virtual collaboration



WORK REQUIREMENTS



• Must be available to work and communicate during US Eastern Time business hours

• High proficiency in written and spoken English required for all communications

• Remote position — must be self-directed and reliable without in-person oversight



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To be considered for this position, please begin your submission or proposal with the sentence: "I AM HUMAN." Applications that do not include this phrase will not be reviewed.



In your cover letter or proposal, please include a brief description of a time you identified a financial issue — billing error, cost anomaly, unauthorized spend, or similar — that others had missed, and describe the steps you took to resolve it. This is the most important thing we want to understand about you.

title: Local B2B Advertising Sales Representative
description:
ABOUT SUMMER HOUSE MEDIA CO.



Summer House Media Co. is an emerging media company focused on creating local advertising opportunities that help small businesses increase visibility in the communities they serve.



Our current offer is a shared direct mail advertising campaign. Local businesses can reserve ad space on a professionally designed 9 x 12 postcard that is mailed to approximately 5,000 households in a targeted local area.



We are seeking a sales professional who can manage the full sales process and support campaign coordination from initial outreach through advertiser onboarding, proof approval, and mailer completion.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Local Advertising Sales Representative will manage the full end-to-end sales cycle and advertiser coordination process for Summer House Media Co.’s Shared Local Mailer program.



This is not an appointment-setting-only role. The selected contractor will be responsible for moving qualified prospects from initial research and outreach through follow-up, objection handling, closing, payment coordination, advertiser intake, proof approval follow-up, and campaign completion.



PRIMARY GOAL



The primary goal is to help fill available paid advertising placements for a monthly shared local mailer while ensuring confirmed advertisers submit the materials and approvals needed to move the postcard into print.



A confirmed paid placement means that a business has selected an advertising tier, submitted payment, and that payment has been received and confirmed.



WHAT YOU WILL BE SELLING



The Shared Local Mailer is a professionally designed 9 x 12 postcard mailed to approximately 5,000 local households in selected ZIP codes or carrier routes.



Businesses can choose from three advertising placement tiers. Premium Anchor Ads are priced at $650. Standard Feature Ads are priced at $475. Starter Local Ads are priced at $325.



Quarterly visibility packages may also be available for businesses that want to appear in multiple consecutive mailings and maintain category visibility over time.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Research and source qualified local businesses within assigned target areas and priority business categories.



Build, organize, and maintain a clean prospect list and sales pipeline.



Conduct cold calls,
 outreach, and approved follow-up communication with local business owners and decision-makers.



Qualify prospects by identifying decision authority, current marketing needs, service area, promotional opportunities, and fit for the mailer.



Present the Shared Local Mailer offer clearly, professionally, and accurately.



Explain placement options, campaign timeline, local household reach, and the value of category visibility.



Follow up consistently with warm leads and und
 prospects through the campaign reservation deadline.



Handle common objections related to cost, timing, current marketing efforts, direct mail, and return on investment.



Help businesses choose between one-time and quarterly placement options.



Ask for the sale and move interested businesses toward a clear decision.



Send or coordinate payment links and follow up until advertiser payment is received.



Document all outreach activity, prospect notes, follow-up dates, sales status, objections, and outcomes in the assigned lead tracker.



Send advertiser intake forms after payment is confirmed.



Collect and organize advertiser materials, including logos, business details, contact information, promotional offers, website links, QR code destinations, photos, and brand preferences when available.



Follow up with advertisers who have incomplete or missing materials before campaign deadlines.



Track advertiser materials, intake completion, placement details, proof status, and approval status.



Coordinate advertiser proof review and collect written approval before final print production.



Follow up with advertisers regarding proof edits, missing approvals, or final corrections.



Maintain organized campaign folders and advertiser records.



Help coordinate final advertiser details for print preparation and mailing.



Notify advertisers when the mailer has been sent or is scheduled to mail.



Begin renewal conversations with advertisers after the campaign is mailed and identify potential quarterly package opportunities.



Provide feedback on lead quality, messaging, objection patterns, high-performing categories, advertiser issues, and opportunities to improve future campaigns.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is confident in outbound sales and comfortable speaking with small business owners and decision-makers.



You should be comfortable owning both top-of-funnel outreach and end-of-funnel conversion, along with basic campaign coordination responsibilities after the sale.



This means you can research prospects, start conversations, build trust, follow up, handle objections, ask for the sale, coordinate payment, collect advertiser materials, manage deadlines, track approvals, and keep the campaign moving forward without requiring constant supervision.



You should be organized, self-directed, professional, consistent with follow-up, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a deadline-driven environment.



Experience in cold calling, business development, local business sales, advertising sales, marketing services, client acquisition, lead generation, account management, sales support, project coordination, or service-based sales is strongly preferred.



Experience selling print media, direct mail, shared mailers, local promotions, agency services, or advertising is helpful but not required.



CAMPAIGN EXPECTATIONS



The selected contractor will be expected to consistently source and contact qualified local businesses, build and manage a pipeline of interested prospects, follow up with warm leads, help secure paid ad placements, collect advertiser materials, track approvals, and maintain organized campaign records throughout the cycle.



Lead sourcing will be shared. Summer House Media Co. will provide target market direction, priority business categories, sales materials, campaign details, and strategic lead guidance. The sales representative will be expected to source and build the majority of the prospect list and outreach opportunities.



COMMUNICATION AND REPORTING EXPECTATIONS



The selected contractor will provide every-other-day progress updates during active outreach.



A weekly summary report will also be required. Weekly reports should include outreach activity, prospect pipeline status, warm leads, paid placements, advertiser intake status, missing materials, proof approvals, common objections, high-performing categories, follow-up priorities, and recommended next steps.



The assigned lead tracker and campaign tracker must be updated consistently throughout the campaign.



Major campaign issues, strong sales opportunities, late-stage prospects, missing advertiser materials, late proof approvals, or risks to the sales or production timeline should be communicated promptly.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Summer House Media Co. will provide a campaign overview, sales timeline, sales flyer, one-page offer sheet, pricing and placement information, sales script, cold
 templates, lead tracker format, campaign tracker format, target business categories, market direction, payment process, advertiser intake process, proofing workflow, automated tools and campaign support.



COMPENSATION



This is a performance-aligned contract.



Compensation details will be discussed with selected candidates. The pilot structure may include a limited hourly component, commission on confirmed paid advertiser placements, and performance bonuses tied to campaign outcomes.





SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE



Success is not measured only by calls made,
s sent, or meetings booked.



Success is measured by consistent prospecting, strong follow-up, organized pipeline management, professional communication, movement of qualified prospects through the full sales cycle, confirmed paid advertising placements, timely advertiser intake, complete materials collection, proof approvals, and a well-organized campaign ready for print.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include a brief summary of your outbound sales, business development, client coordination, or campaign support experience.



Please describe your experience cold calling small businesses, local business owners, or decision-makers.



Please share any experience selling advertising, marketing services, local promotions, print media, direct mail, agency services, or service-based offers.



Please include your availability.



Please provide a brief example of a campaign where you helped generate leads, appointments, closed sales, collected client materials, coordinated approvals, or supported campaign delivery.

title: Account Manager / Project Manager
description:
Account Manager / Project Manager 



Contract







We are a premium podcast and video studio. We produce and publish shows for founders and businesses, handling everything from brand to final episode. We have the editors, designers, and studio team in place. We need one person to run the machine between them and our clients.



The role



You are the person who keeps every project moving and every client informed. You own the production board, push our editors and designers to hit their dates, and act as the point of contact for clients through their feedback and approvals. You are not editing, designing, or selling. You are coordinating the people who do, and keeping clients informed while it happens. If you are organized, a clear writer, and you like making sure nothing slips, this is your seat.



What you'll own



Run the board. Manage our projects in ClickUp. Open client and episode tasks, set start dates, and move every project through its stages so nothing stalls or gets forgotten.



Push the team. Assign work to our editors and designers, set their deadlines, and follow up to make sure they deliver on time. Chase politely but persistently. Keeping people on schedule is the core of the job.



Be the client's point of contact. Send clients their project updates and review links at each milestone using our templates. Collect their feedback, route revision requests to the right editor, and run the brand-kit concept selection back and forth. Keep every client feeling looked after.



Publish. Once an episode is approved internally, publish it. Upload episodes to the client's podcast platforms (YouTube, Spotify, Apple) and schedule their social clips through Buffer. Send the "you're live"
 when it's done. Not all clients will require publishing.



Set up new clients. When a new client comes on, collect their intake, gather platform access during onboarding, and confirm everything is connected before production starts.



What you won't do



You won't edit video, design graphics, run quality control on the final work, or handle sales. Your job is project management, coordination and client communication.



Tools you'll use:



ClickUp (project management), Buffer (social scheduling), Gmail / Google Workspace, 
, and the podcast platforms (YouTube, Spotify for Creators, Apple Podcasts). We'll train you on our setup. Experience with any of these is a plus.



What we're looking for



Excellent written English. You'll be
ing clients directly, so your writing needs to be clear, warm, and professional. We use templates to help.

Strong organization. You can hold many moving projects at once and let nothing drop.

Reliable and self-directed. You follow a process without being reminded and flag problems before they become fires. But you ASK questions.

Comfortable following up with people. You can chase a deadline without being rude and without letting it slide.

Detail-oriented. Names spelled right, links correct, dates accurate.





Nice to have



Prior ClickUp experience

Familiarity with social scheduling tools





Logistics



Remote. Part-time to start



How to apply



Send a short note telling us about a time you kept a project or a team on track, and any experience you have with the tools above. Keep it brief. We care more about how clearly you write than how long.

title: Dating Profile Copywriter (NO AI)
description:
Help Men Attract Their Dream Woman Through Exceptional Dating Profile Writing



We helped more than 300+ high-achieving male clients from 100+ cities around the world get more matches, more dates and achieve their dream dating life in part by optimising our clients' online dating profiles.. We are one of the fastest growing companies in the industry.



We are happy to become one of your strongest testimonials that you can use further line down in you career. We are happy to give video, textual, any kinds of testimonials, and the work you produce for us you can use as proof of your abilities as well.



If you prove to be an A-player, there are opportunities for you to advance to a higher position in the company and perhaps even a full-time role.



We're looking for an exceptional writer who understands attraction, psychology, storytelling, and online dating at a deep level.



This is not traditional copywriting.



You won't be writing blog posts, advertisements, sales pages, or social media content.



Instead, you'll be crafting high-converting dating profiles for men on Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble.



Your job is to transform ordinary information about a client into a profile that immediately captures attention, creates intrigue, sparks attraction, and dramatically increases the likelihood that women swipe right, start conversations, and ultimately agree to dates.



What You'll Be Writing



For each client, you'll create:



Tinder bios

Bumble bios

Hinge prompts

Bumble prompts

Tinder profile prompts and profile text

Job title optimization

Occupation descriptions

Profile positioning and messaging

Alternative profile variations for testing



What Success Looks Like



The profiles you write should:



Attract the specific type of woman the client wants to meet

Differentiate the client from thousands of other men

Create curiosity and emotional engagement

Encourage women to swipe right

Encourage women to message first whenever possible

Make conversations start positively from the very first message

Create a natural pathway toward meeting in person

Feel authentic, natural, and completely aligned with the client's personality



The goal is not simply to write something funny or clever.



The goal is to strategically position the client so women are excited to match with him before a conversation even begins.



Who We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if:



You have extensive experience writing dating profiles

You deeply understand male-female attraction dynamics

You understand what women actually respond to on dating apps

You can write in multiple styles and personalities

You know how to create intrigue without sounding try-hard

You can make a profile feel confident, attractive, and authentic

You are an excellent interviewer and can quickly understand a client's personality

You have strong attention to detail

You consistently produce original work



Non-Negotiable Requirements

ABSOLUTELY NO AI-GENERATED WRITING



This role is for a genuine writer.



We are not looking for someone who generates content using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Jasper, or any other AI writing tool.



Every profile must be written from scratch by a human.



We have extensive experience reviewing dating profiles and can immediately identify content that feels AI-generated.



If there is even the slightest indication that AI was used to write, heavily assist, or generate any part of the profile, your application will be rejected immediately and you will no longer be considered for future work.



We are specifically looking for writers who can produce original, natural, human-sounding content that reflects real personality, emotional intelligence, and nuanced social understanding.



To Apply



Please submit:



A brief introduction about yourself

Any experience writing dating profiles, personal branding content, or similar work



Follow these steps:

1. Open our Fulfillment Team Tracker: 
/spreadsheets/d/140BpHakCi0MkYrmsq2MWy9v70wPefTVQ__aWCR2Cxhg/edit?usp=sharing



2. Pick one of our clients. Using the information the clients provided about themselves, write a Tinder/Bumble bio and 3 Hinge prompts. (If the client did not provide relevant info, just make up one.) The three Hinge prompts should start with...



a. "Together we could... "*insert here the romantic date idea. Be very specific about the details on the date (eg. location, what you're doing during the date) and use vivid imagery to make them visualise what it's like to go on a date with our male client. For example, "Together we could...watch the sunset over a glass of wine at the beach, and talk about our biggest dreams and fears."



b. My humble brag is/My greatest strength is.. *insert here what they are good at. Ideally, it would be something that could be related to the girl. For example, if a client works in sales, you can say "My humble brag is...I can convince you do whatever I want ;)". Another example: "My humble brag is...I'm essentially an expert in female psychology. "



c. The way to win me over is/Win me over by... *insert here a quality (that is not about her looks) that the client wants from his dream girl. The purpose of this prompt is to convey that he has standards, that he won't be satisfied with just any random girl, and to make the woman qualify or prove that she, in fact, possesses the qualities he desires. For example... "The way to win me over is...being able to cook me a nice ribeye with a cheeky kiss on the cheek."



The prompts should be fun, flirty, playful. It should focus on ONE key idea and elaborate on that one idea as opposed to listing different things. There should be no repetition of words or ideas in different parts of the profile. It should make the woman excited to get to know our male client and ideally make them want to go out with them on a date. Avoid generic lines, clichés, and recycled dating-app tropes.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-ter
mber of our team and help our clients achieve exceptional results on Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble.



Current or former dating coach, matchmaker, relationship writer, personal branding writer, or exceptional dating-app user strongly preferred.

title: Shopify Implementation Specialist

Tomorrow Studios is a Shopify design and implementation studio based in British Columbia, Canada. We help merchants move to Shopify, clean up their product data, configure apps and systems, and launch stores that are easy to manage. You'll organize product, customer, and order data; configure Shopify settings and apps; test store functionality; document your work; and help with client launches.

Use tools such as Matrixify to import and export products, customers, orders, redirects, and metafields

Support migrations from BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, and CSV files

Configure Shopify settings: products, collections, markets, shipping, taxes, payments, locations, staff permissions, and sales channels

Set up and configure Shopify apps based on project needs

Work with metafields, metaobjects, tags, product options, and redirects

Support Shopify POS and B2B configuration when needed

Do QA before and after launch (product, checkout, app, redirect, mobile, and content checks)

Document your completed work, open issues, and client instructions

Communicate clearly with the team and, when needed, with clients

Flag technical issues that need custom development





Nice to have (not required)





Basic Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

Familiarity with the Shopify theme editor and Online Store 2.0

Experience with Shopify Plus, POS, or B2B

Experience with BigCommerce or WooCommerce

Experience with ERP, accounting, inventory, reviews, subscriptions, loyalty, or
 marketing apps

SEO migration basics (redirects and metadata)

Experience working with an agency or multiple clients





Who we're looking for





Very strong attention to detail

Comfortable with spreadsheets and structured data

Clear written English

Reliable follow-through and clear documentation

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

Able to work independently after getting direction

Willing to learn new Shopify apps and workflows





Details: Full-time, long-term, work from home. Approximately 30–40 hours/week with meaningful daily overlap with Pacific Time (we'll confirm hours together).





Before you apply (please read carefully):



We read every application, and we want people who actually read the whole job post. To show us you did:





Begin your application by telling us your favorite animal. Applications that don't start with an animal will be skipped.

In 2–3 sentences, explain how you would migrate a product catalogue from BigCommerce to Shopify — including which tool you'd use to import the data and one thing you'd check before the store goes live.

title: Amazon Marketplace Specialist - Wholesale / Online Arbitrage
description:
We are an e-commerce business expanding into Amazon Marketplace resale. We’re looking for a full-time Amazon Marketplace Specialist with hands-on experience in Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, product research, ungating/category approval, and supplier sourcing.



This role supports our Amazon account by focusing on product opportunities, supplier/source research, approval support, deal analysis, and sales planning. We sell existing products on Amazon, not private label. Our existing team can support fulfillment, tracking, and customer service when needed.



Note: We value the right fit and will conduct a 2-4 weeks probation period.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Product Research: Find profitable existing ASINs for resale using tools such as Keepa, SellerAmp, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Tactical Arbitrage, or similar tools.

- Deal Analysis: Analyze sales rank, Buy Box, FBA competition, price history, monthly sales, ROI, margin, Amazon fees, break-even price, and suggested order quantity.

- Approval Support: Help with ungating, brand approval, and category approval requirements, including invoices, product photos, authorization letters, or other documents when needed.

- Supplier Sourcing: Research and contact wholesalers, distributors, brands, and online sources to find profitable and reliable supply.

- Wholesale / OA Support: Review supplier price lists, online arbitrage leads, MOQs, lead times, shipping costs, and replenishment potential.

- Account Oversight: Monitor restrictions, risky brands, IP complaint risks, hazmat/meltable status, account health issues, and Amazon compliance risks.

- Sales Planning: Recommend products to test, quantity to purchase, fulfillment method when relevant, and when to replenish based on sales velocity and available capital.

- Reporting: Provide weekly updates on product leads, supplier outreach, approval status, purchase recommendations, inventory status, and sales performance.



WHAT YOU DON’T NEED TO DO

- Daily customer service

- Daily order tracking

- Manual fulfillment tasks, unless coordination is needed with our team



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience with Amazon Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, or related Amazon resale work

- Strong understanding of Keepa, Seller Central, Buy Box, sales rank, Amazon fees, and Amazon profitability

- Experience with ungating, brand approval, or category approval

- Experience contacting suppliers, distributors, brands, or sourcing from online retailers

- Ability to calculate ROI, margin, profit, break-even price, sales velocity, and recommended purchase quantity

- Ability to identify risky brands, restricted products, hazmat, meltable items, and IP complaint risks

- Strong English communication skills, especially for supplier outreach

- Able to work independently and collaborate with our team

- Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace

- Able to work 9am-6pm Hong Kong / PH time (you will need to job in our team 
 during working hour)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience opening wholesale accounts

- Existing knowledge of reliable US distributors, wholesalers, online sourcing sites, or prep centers

- Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or client accounts

- Experience with InventoryLab, ScanUnlimited, BuyBotPro, Tactical Arbitrage, or repricing tools

- Experience building SOPs or product research spreadsheets



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

- Understands Amazon resale, not private label

- Can find realistic opportunities, not just random product leads

- Is careful with compliance, account health, and supplier quality

- Takes responsibility for their work and reports clearly

- Wants to grow with a long-term e-commerce team



COMPENSATION

Probation Period - PHP 18,000

Bonus (during probation period) 

- Add. PHP 5,000 if your listing can drive sales to >$15K monthly sales (Total PHP 23,000) (with margin)

- Add. PHP10,000 if your listing can drive sales to >$25K monthly sales (Total PHP 28,000) (with margin)

- More bonus is applicable based on your performance





APPLICATION PROCESS

- Submit your resume/CV and a short cover letter detailing your Amazon Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, ungating, and supplier sourcing experience.

- Please include specific examples of products, approvals, supplier outreach, or accounts you helped support. We prefer detailed examples over general tool lists. 

- If available, include screenshots, sample product research sheets, supplier outreach examples, or approval/support case examples.

 subject: “I want to work with you - Amazon Marketplace Specialist - [Your Name]” 



HINT

We appreciate candidates who truly have experience and are able to demonstrate it, instead of only writing about it in an
. We know many candidates now use AI to write application
s, so if you do not submit any proof, such as screenshots, your own product research history, or any other material that can showcase your experience, you may be screened out right away if your application looks like an AI-written or canned
 used for all job posts.

title: 2D Animator
description:
About the role:



BattlePaws is looking for a long-term, full-time 2D animator for YouTube content focused on history, mythology, battles, and immersive storytelling videos.



The channel style is inspired by:



- DumbDoggoAnimation — 

 -TheOdd1sOut — 

 -HeyHistorically — 

 -Fast-paced YouTube storytelling animation



The goal is NOT Disney-level animation quality. Strong pacing, comedic timing, visual storytelling, and retention-focused animation matter more than ultra-smooth frame-by-frame work.



Production expectations: 



 Average video length: 10–15 minutes

 Expected workload: 3 videos per month

 Future goal: 30-minute videos as the channel grows

 Minimum export quality: 1080p

 Animation software: any (After Effects, Animate, Toon Boom, Blender, etc.)



Workflow & communication



 Trello is used for project management and production tracking.

 A WhatsApp group is used for daily communication and feedback.

 English does not need to be perfect — but you must be able to clearly understand simple instructions and scripts.



What BattlePaws provides for each video: 



 Full script

 Voice-over (recorded)

 Storyboard images

All final animations and assets created for the channel belong to BattlePaws



Recruitment & filtering process: 



Step 1 — Initial Application Filter



Applicants are first filtered based on:



 Portfolio quality

 Communication

 Responsiveness

 Compatibility with the channel style

This first pass is mainly used to remove low-effort or incompatible applicants and is not heavily scored.



Required in your application (in this order):



1. Start with the word: Legion

2. Brief intro — your name, country, and years of 2D animation experience

3. Confirm you can work FULL-TIME (30–40 hrs/week, ~3 videos/month minimum)

4. Portfolio link (past animation work — at least 2–3 samples)

5. Animation software you use most

6. Your time zone (so we know if we can sync via WhatsApp)

Applications that don't include all six items above, or that don't start with "Legion," will be ignored.



Step 2 — Paid Animation Test

Selected applicants from Step 1 will be invited to a paid animation test.

The test materials are hosted in this read-only Google Drive folder:







Inside you'll find:



 The full brief (READ FIRST/)

 3 scenes of script + voice-over + storyboard images (References/, Storyboards/, Voice Over/)

 A preview MP4 showing scene-change timing

 Channel style references and mascot turntable

The storyboard is creative guidance, not strict frame-by-frame instructions. Creative improvements are welcome if they fit the channel style.



The test evaluates:



 Pacing

 Comedic timing

 Visual clarity

 Ability to follow instructions

 Communication

 Workflow organization

 Overall YouTube retention quality



Technical requirements: 



 Resolution: 1920 × 1080

 Frame rate: 30 fps

 Export format: MP4 (H.264)



Required deliverables:



 Final MP4 export

 Project files

 Assets used during production



Time & deadline: 



 Approximately 4–6 hours of work expected

 Hard deadline: 48–72 hours from receiving the test

 Smooth animation is not the priority — strong storytelling, efficient workflow, and engaging pacing matter more



How to submit:



When finished, upload your deliverables (MP4, project files, assets) to your own Google Drive folder set to view-only, then submit the link via our submission form:







The form takes ~1 minute to fill out. Do not
 files directly — the form is the only submission channel.



Step 3 — Final Selection :

The later stages of recruitment become much more selective. The final decision is based on:

 Reliability

 Communication

 Speed

 Consistency

 Ability to work long-term within the BattlePaws production pipeline



If you're officially selected after the test phase, you receive a $75 USD bonus alongside your first project's compensation.

Payment structure



 Month 1: paid per video at the starting rate

 Month 2+: increased per-video pay for strong performance

 Long-term top performers: transition into a stable full-time position with performance bonuses tied to video success



Ready to apply?



Send your application via this job post. Follow the 6-item checklist in Step 1 above — that's the only thing we check at the first pass.



We respond to all serious applications, even if it's a 'no' — silence isn't our style.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

— The BattlePaws Team

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

This role requires hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts, driving sales growth, and optimizing operations across multiple regions. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and has a proven track record of successfully navigating international e-commerce environments.

* Implement Amazon advertising campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, etc.) to maximize ROI.

* Ensure compliance with Amazon policies, international trade regulations, and local laws.

* Collaborate with marketing, logistics, and product teams to execute promotions and launches.



Qualifications:

* 3-5 years of proven experience managing Amazon accounts in one or more international marketplaces.

* Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, and related tools.

* Demonstrated experience with Amazon SEO, advertising, and account optimization strategies.

* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.

* Strong project management skills and attention to detail.

title: Business Research & Communication Assistant
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and resourceful Business Research & Communication Assistant to support business research, information verification, and external communications.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding answers, analyzing information, verifying facts, and communicating with organizations to obtain accurate and reliable information.

AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar platforms can be valuable research tools and are encouraged when appropriate. However, the goal is not simply to generate answers using AI. The ideal candidate must be able to verify information through independent research, official sources, documentation, and direct communication with relevant organizations when necessary.

We are looking for someone who can determine what information is accurate, reliable, and actionable—not just what information is easy to find.

________________________________________

Responsibilities

• Research business, product, and industry-related topics using online resources, official documentation, and other available channels

• Verify information by cross-checking multiple sources and assessing their reliability

• Contact organizations, suppliers, service providers, and other third parties to obtain or confirm information when necessary

• Identify inconsistencies, gaps, or unanswered questions and proactively seek clarification

• Organize findings into clear, concise, and actionable summaries

• Maintain accurate records of research findings, communications, and ongoing inquiries

• Follow up on outstanding requests and track progress until issues are resolved

• Respond promptly to research requests and provide timely updates on progress

• Support business decision-making by providing accurate, well-researched, and verified information

• Assist with other business-related projects as needed

________________________________________

Requirements

• Excellent research, information-gathering, and problem-solving skills

• Strong analytical thinking and ability to verify information from multiple sources

• Ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and unanswered questions

• Excellent written English and professional communication skills

• Comfortable contacting organizations by
, phone, or online support channels

• Detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and highly reliable

• Able to work independently, manage priorities, and follow through on tasks

• Proficient with Google Workspace, online research tools, and AI tools such as ChatGPT or Perplexity

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience as a Research Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Customer Support Representative, Administrative Assistant, or a similar role

• Experience working with startups or small businesses

• Experience handling business inquiries and external communications

• Experience conducting market, supplier, compliance, regulatory, or product research

________________________________________

What We Value Most

We are not looking for someone who simply searches for answers online or copies information generated by AI tools.

We value individuals who can:

• Verify information through multiple sources

• Distinguish between assumptions, opinions, and verified facts

• Evaluate the credibility of information sources

• Identify inconsistencies and missing information

• Contact organizations directly when clarification is needed

• Exercise sound judgment and provide reasoned conclusions

The ability to determine what information is accurate, reliable, and actionable is more important than simply finding information.

________________________________________

Application

Please provide your resume and  answer this question:

1. How you verify information when different sources provide conflicting answers and how you verify information provided by AI.

title: IT Support Analyst
description:
Job description:



The Technical Support Specialist provides Tier 1 technical support to customers experiencing issues with their VoIP phone systems and network connectivity services. This is a fast-paced role that involves managing support requests via phone,
, and ticketing systems.



Key Responsibilities



The specialist is the frontline expert responsible for diagnosing and resolving a wide range of issues.



VoIP/PBX System Support

-Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues related to VoIP (Voice over IP), SIP (Session Initiation Protocol), and PBX (Private Branch Exchange) systems (both physical and cloud-based like FreePBX, 3CX, or Cisco CUCM).

-Assist with the provisioning, configuration, and deployment of new VoIP handsets, soft phones, and system extensions.

-Resolve common call quality issues, such as jitter, latency, and echo, often requiring the analysis of call logs or packet captures (Wireshark).



Network and Connectivity Troubleshooting

-Troubleshoot network issues impacting voice communication quality, including local area network (LAN) and wide area network (WAN) connectivity.

-Configure and troubleshoot customer-side network devices like routers, modems, and firewalls to ensure proper Quality of Service (QoS) and port forwarding for VoIP traffic.

-Provide support for network fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs.



Ticketing and Documentation

-Accurately log, track, and manage customer issues using a ticketing system (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk).

-Create and maintain high-quality internal and customer facing documentation (knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides).

-Escalate unresolved issues to senior engineering or infrastructure teams when necessary.



Required Qualifications:

-Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

-Experience in a 24/7 support environment and willingness to work rotational shifts and holidays.

-1+ year experience deploying and/or testing VoIP systems or solutions\

-1+ year experience in telecommunications

-1+ years isolating and repairing VoIP system faults/misconfigurations and/or determining interoperability issues

-Experience with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routers and IP routing, and switches

-Familiarity with VoIP devices, i.e. Linksys PAP2, SPA 9000, and “soft phones”

-Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and customer service skills

-Good written and verbal communication skills in English

-Certifications/Licenses: Relevant technical certifications (CCNA, CompTIA Network+,

-CompTIA A+, or specific vendor certifications for Cisco, Microsoft, or VoIP platforms)



Preferred Skills

-Experience with cloud-hosted PBX platforms (e.g., FreePBX, 3CX, RingCentral, Sangoma).

-Familiarity with Wireshark, network analyzers, and SIP troubleshooting tools.

-Ability to manage high call volumes and multitask effectively in a fast-paced support environment.



Core Competencies

-Exceptional problem-solving and analytical abilities for effective root cause analysis.

-Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical users with patience and clarity.

-Customer-Centric Focus with a commitment to delivering high-quality service and timely resolutions.

-Ability to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous tasks in a high-pressure, dynamic environment.



Technical Skills

-Expert knowledge of VoIP protocols (e.g., SIP, RTP, Codecs) and their role in telecommunications.

-Proven experience with PBX/Unified Communications platforms (e.g., Asterisk, FreePBX, Cisco, Avaya).

-Strong foundation in networking fundamentals (CompTIA Network+ or CCNA level knowledge).

-Experience troubleshooting modem and router configurations for various internet service types.

-Familiarity with network diagnostic tools like ping, traceroute, and packet sniffers.

-Proficiency with operating systems like Windows and Linux CLI (Command Line Interface) for system checks and management.

title: Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Operations (Remote, PH)
description:
We're Hiring · Remote

Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Operations



Help a fast-growing custom-fashion startup turn perfect-fit garments into a thriving brand. You'll run our social presence, stand up our Meta business tooling, test new features so they ship fast, and keep our business-development and artisan-success work moving. (Company name shared with shortlisted candidates.)



• Remote (Philippines-based)

• Hired via OnlineJobs.ph

• Supports a US / Austin, TX startup

• Part-time ? Full-time path



ABOUT US

We turn the anxiety of buying clothes from afar into the joy of connection. We pair customers with skilled artisans to deliver perfect-fit custom garments — combining a delightful online customization experience with a hands-on artisan network. We're an early-stage, bootstrapped startup moving fast toward launch, and we're building a small, sharp team that cares about craft. We're keeping our brand name confidential at this stage — we'll share it once we connect.



THE ROLE

We're looking for a reliable, detail-obsessed Virtual Assistant who can wear several hats well: own our day-to-day social media, set up and maintain our Meta business accounts, manually test new features and flows so we can ship quickly, and support both our business-development outreach and our artisan-success team. You don't need to write code — but you do need to be organized, a clear communicator in English, and genuinely careful.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Social media — plan, create, schedule, and post across our channels, and engage our community.

- Meta Business setup — set up and maintain our Meta Business Suite, shops/catalog, and WhatsApp Business.

- Software testing (manual QA / UAT) — test new features and report bugs clearly so we can ship quickly.

- Business development support — help with outreach, research, and keeping the pipeline organized.

- Artisan success support — help onboard artisans and keep records and content up to date.

- General admin — inbox, calendar, files, and simple process documentation.



WHO YOU ARE

Required:

- 2+ years as a VA, social media coordinator, or similar.

- Excellent written English and clear communication.

- Hands-on with Canva and social scheduling tools.

- Comfortable in (or quick to learn) Meta Business Suite.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable.

- A careful tester's mindset — you notice when something is "off" and document it precisely.

- Reliable computer and stable internet; available during the daily overlap window.



Nice to Have:

- E-commerce, DTC, or fashion-brand experience.

- Familiarity with manually testing web apps and writing bug reports.

- Light video editing (CapCut/Reels).

- WhatsApp Business setup experience.

- Comfort with tools like Notion, Trello, or ClickUp.

- Interest in African fashion and the diaspora market.



HOURS & TIME ZONE

This is a Part-time · ~20 hrs/week role to start. Manila (PHT) runs about 13 hours ahead of Austin (CDT), which actually works in our favor — your morning is our evening, giving us a live daily window to sync.

- Your hours (Manila / PHT): ~7:00 AM – 11:00 AM, Mon–Fri

- Founder's window (Austin / CDT): ~6:00 PM – 10:00 PM, prev. day

- Purpose: Daily overlap for assignments, questions, review & testing turnaround

- Optional flexible weekend block (Manila daytime) for content prep & catch-up.



Exact hours are flexible and set together — the only firm requirement is a consistent daily overlap with the founder's evening window.



WHY PART-TIME FIRST

We're matching the assistant's hours to the founder's evening review capacity, so work gets unblocked quickly rather than stalling. We begin part-time (~20 hrs/week) scheduled in the assistant's morning hours, with a clear path to full-time once there's a consistent backlog you can run autonomously, social + QA are operating against SOPs without hand-holding, and async work flows smoothly for next-evening review.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

- Days 1–30: Meta Business Suite fully set up and verified; social calendar live and posting consistently; first UAT passes completed with clean bug reports.

- Days 31–60: Steady posting cadence with measurable engagement growth; a working regression checklist; faster test-to-fix turnaround within the daily overlap.

- Days 61–90: Running social, QA, and admin largely from SOPs with light supervision — the point at which we discuss expanding to full-time.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

Canva · Meta Business Suite & Commerce Manager · a social scheduler (e.g. Buffer / Later / Metricool) · WhatsApp Business · Google Workspace · a project tool (Notion / Trello / ClickUp) · Loom (screen recordings for bug reports) · and our web app for testing.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Put "CRAFT-VA" in your application subject line so we know you read this fully.

2. Share 2–3 social accounts you've managed (links) and one piece of content you're proud of.

3. In a few sentences, describe a time you spotted and reported a bug or error — what you noticed and how you documented it.

4. Confirm you can work the morning overlap hours (Manila time) described above.

5. Optional but a plus: a 60-second Loom intro in English.

Australian working experience is required.

description:
