Position Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote



Role Overview: 

The Accounts Receivable VA will manage the end-to-end invoicing and collection process for multiple client accounts. This role focuses on maintaining healthy cash flow, reducing debtors' days, and executing polite but persistent follow-ups with an authentic, professional demeanor.



Standard Must-Haves: 

* These are the non-negotiable baselines for ensuring quality service and data security:

* Exceptional English Proficiency: Clear, professional, and confident spoken and written English, capable of navigating varied client personalities (specifically trade/civil construction dynamics).

* Prior AR/Collections Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of dedicated experience handling high-volume collections and invoicing.

* Software Competency: Proficiency in Xero and/or QuickBooks Online.

* Data Security Compliance: Agreement to strict privacy policies, secure data protection protocols, and utilization of platforms like Practice Protect or 1Password.

* Infrastructure: A reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet home office setup, and a high-functioning computer capable of running integrated VOIP software.



Preferences (The "Nice-to-Haves"): 

* These attributes will separate a standard applicant from a top-tier performer who seamlessly integrates into your workflow:

* Industry Familiarity: Previous experience dealing with Australian trade businesses, subcontractors, or civil construction clients.



Tech Stack Adaptability: Experience with project management and job management software (e.g., SimPRO, Jobber, Tradify) or reporting tools (e.g., Scoro).

Proactive Problem Solver: Ability to look at an aging debtor ledger and independently strategize the prioritization of calls.

Job Description (Duties & Responsibilities): 

Debtor Ledger Management: Oversee and review outstanding ledgers across approximately 45+ small business and trade clients.

Proactive Collection Calls: Conduct consistent, polite, and systematic follow-up phone calls to chase outstanding invoices.

 Correspondence: Issue formal statements, payment reminders, and letters of demand when necessary.

Meticulous Record-Keeping: Log comprehensive notes, call logs, and customer feedback directly into the CRM/accounting software after every interaction to ensure full transparency.

Payment Plan Negotiation: Establish and monitor structured payment plans for long-overdue accounts within parameters pre-approved by the client.

Queries & Dispute Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for billing discrepancies, escalating complex accounting issues to the bookkeeping team while keeping the collection process moving.



Key Requirements & Metrics (KPIs): 

* To ensure this role drives tangible profitability and efficiency, progress should be measured against the following key metrics:

* Reduction in Average Debtors' Days: Successfully bringing outstanding balances down toward target windows (e.g., shifting 62-day averages closer to a 14-to-30-day window).

* Call and Touchpoint Volume: Maintaining an agreed-upon standard of daily/weekly outbound touchpoints across the client portfolio.

* Data Accuracy: Ensuring 100% compliance with logging notes so that anyone reviewing a client account instantly knows the exact status of a collection.

title: Tech/Appt Entry VA
description:
We are a fast-growing med spa patient acquisition agency based in the US, and we are looking for a sharp, technically savvy VA to join our team part-time with real potential to grow into a full-time role as we scale.



This is not your average VA role. We need someone who genuinely loves figuring things out, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can jump between platforms and tasks without missing a beat. If you get excited when you encounter a new piece of software and your first instinct is to figure it out rather than ask for help, this role is for you.





What You Will Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be building out client backends. This includes setting up GoHighLevel (GHL) sub-accounts, configuring HotProspector dialing accounts, and handling calendar integrations across multiple clients. Each client has a different setup, different software, and a different way of doing things, so no two days will look the same.

Beyond that, you will own the technical side of our operations. If something breaks, if a new integration needs to be built, or if a workflow needs to be fixed, that lands on your plate. You will be our go-to person for anything tech-related until we build out a more structured team around you.



Core Responsibilities



-Build and configure GHL sub-accounts for new and existing clients

-Set up and manage HotProspector accounts

-Build, troubleshoot, and maintain calendar integrations across various platforms (Google Calendar, ClubReady, Jane, PatientNow, Square, and others)

-Book inbound leads directly into clinic scheduling software, ensuring accurate appointment entry across each client's specific booking system

-Build and manage automations and workflows using 
 and GHL's native automation tools

-Troubleshoot and maintain Google Sheets and light Google Apps Script when needed

-Handle any technical tasks that arise across the agency day to day



What We Need You to Know



GoHighLevel (GHL) – you must have hands-on experience building inside the platform, not just using it


 or similar automation tools (Zapier, n8n) – you need to understand how automations and multi-step workflows are built and how to troubleshoot them



Google Calendar integrations – experience syncing calendars across different platforms and solving integration issues in real time



Google Sheets – comfortable building, troubleshooting, and organizing data



Clinic booking software – experience entering or managing appointments inside platforms like Jane, PatientNow, Square, or similar systems is a strong plus



What You Will Learn on the Job



HotProspector – we will train you, but you need to be someone who picks up new platforms fast

Our specific client systems and workflows



Who You Are



You are genuinely tech savvy, not just comfortable with computers but someone who actively enjoys solving technical problems

You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to learn faster, troubleshoot smarter, and get things done without waiting to be spoon-fed answers

You are a critical thinker who can hop on a call with a client, encounter a calendar software you have never seen before, and figure out the integration on the spot

You communicate clearly and proactively, especially when something is not working

You take ownership of your tasks and do not need hand-holding to get things done

You are reliable, responsive, and take pride in your work



Why Join Scale 77

This is a ground-floor opportunity with a company that is growing fast. The person who fills this role will have direct exposure to the founders, real responsibility from day one, and a clear path to grow into a full-time, higher-paying position as we expand. We are not looking for someone to fill a seat, we are looking for someone to grow with us.



To Apply

Please include the following in your application:



A brief summary of your GHL experience and what you have built inside the platform

Any calendar integration experience you have, including what platforms were involved

Any experience booking appointments or entering leads into clinic or healthcare scheduling software

Your availability and time zone



Applications without these details will not be reviewed.

title: Amazon Product Development and Sourcing Specialist | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: Implementation & Operations Specialist
description:
About Pharmesol

Pharmesol’s AI Pharmacy Assistant automates routine tasks and conversations so pharmacy teams can spend more time delivering exceptional patient care.

We build pharmacy-specific AI systems that understand pharmacy workflows, medications, and patient interactions. Our technology is already live in pharmacies across the U.S., helping teams reduce operational burden while improving the patient experience.

We are a fast-growing company operating at the intersection of healthcare and AI. The pace is high, the problems are complex, and the expectations are demanding. If you enjoy solving real operational problems and building systems that directly impact patient care, you will find this work deeply rewarding.



About the Role

We are looking for an Implementation Associate who will own the deployment of Pharmesol’s system with pharmacy customers.

This is not a coordination or project management role. You will be responsible for figuring out how Pharmesol should actually work within each pharmacy’s operations.

Every pharmacy operates differently. Departments change, workflows evolve, and edge cases appear constantly. Your job is to understand those details, design the correct workflow, and ensure the system behaves exactly as intended.

You will work directly with pharmacy teams to map workflows, configure automation logic, test scenarios, and ensure a successful launch.

At any given time you may be managing ~10 active implementations simultaneously, each with different operational nuances. The work requires exceptional attention to detail, strong reasoning ability, and the discipline to track many moving pieces without things slipping through the cracks.

You will work closely with engineering, operations, and sales, but you own the implementation outcome end-to-end.



Responsibilities

Customer Implementation

Lead implementation calls with pharmacy teams and operational stakeholders

Deeply understand each pharmacy’s workflows, operational constraints, and edge cases

Design how Pharmesol should integrate into those workflows

Configure and test automation logic to ensure the system behaves correctly

Identify missing information, inconsistencies, or operational risks during setup

Run scenario testing to validate system behavior before launch

Launch new customers and ensure the system performs as intended



Operational Problem Solving

Break down complex workflows into clear automation logic

Anticipate edge cases and operational exceptions before they cause issues

Diagnose problems quickly and determine whether the root cause is configuration, workflow, or system behavior

Work closely with engineering when product changes are required



Customer Ownership

Maintain clear communication with pharmacy teams during implementation

Ensure expectations are clear and timelines move forward

In some cases, continue managing the account after launch or transition it to another tea
mber



About You

This role is best suited for someone who naturally thinks in systems and details. Much of the job involves noticing inconsistencies, asking the right follow-up questions, and working through operational edge cases before they cause problems.

You will likely do well in this role if the following feels natural to you:

You notice inconsistencies quickly. When someone explains a workflow, you instinctively identify missing steps, unclear assumptions, or edge cases.



You ask the right questions. You are comfortable probing until you fully understand how something actually works in practice.



You can translate real-world processes into clear logic. You enjoy breaking down complex workflows into structured steps that can be implemented in a system.



You stay organized across many parallel threads. You can manage ~10 implementations at once while keeping decisions, workflow logic, and next steps clearly documented.



You take ownership for outcomes. If something is unclear or not working as expected, you investigate and resolve it rather than waiting for direction.



You operate well in fast-moving environments. Priorities shift quickly, and you can context switch frequently without losing accuracy or attention to detail.



This Role May Not Be a Good Fit If

You struggle to context switch frequently. In this role, priorities shift often and you may move between multiple implementations throughout the day while still maintaining focus and accuracy.



You are uncomfortable receiving direct, candid feedback. We value fast learning and open communication.



Your default reaction when something goes wrong is to blame external factors or other people, rather than first asking what you could have done differently.



You prefer environments where responsibilities are narrowly defined. This role requires high ownership and the ability to figure things out independently.



Experience

2+ years of professional experience (excluding internships)

Previous experience working in a fast-paced startup environment required

Experience with U.S. healthcare operations strongly preferred

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience



Technical / Operational Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

Comfortable learning new systems and workflows quickly

Highly organized in tracking many concurrent details

You have personally built or configured AI or automation workflows (not just used ChatGPT for writing).



Hiring Process

Because this role requires a high degree of ownership and independent thinking, our hiring process is rigorous.

Final candidates should expect:

Three reference calls, including at least two former direct managers

Background check



Why This Role Is Unique

You will be working directly on the operational layer where AI meets real healthcare workflows.

The problems are rarely obvious, the environments are constantly changing, and the solutions require both careful thinking and practical judgment.

If you enjoy solving messy real-world problems and building systems that make frontline healthcare teams more effective, this role offers significant ownership and growth potential.

title: Senior Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
I run a residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California, and am looking for an experienced residential appraisal writer to join the team. The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for an experienced and senior level residential report writer to join our team.



Your role will be to do the following:

1. Complete the entire residential appraisal report after the appraiser has provided you with the inspection information and comparables. This includes all the commentary, adjustments, and all other parts of the report. We will provide training on how we specifically expect the commentary and adjustments based on our own personal preferences, however you are expected to already have this type of experience working for other appraisers.

2. Review the work of other report writers on our team, provide feedback, and help train newer report writers on our team. You are expected to act as the "last line of defense" of the report before it is sent to the appraiser for their final review before submission. As such, we expect you to be able to review the report, find any issues, correct these issues, and then send to the appraiser a near perfect report.



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have worked for a US residential appraiser

2. You have experience performing data entry for residential properties in the US

3. You have experience creating the 1004MC, selecting comparables, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, making adjustments to the sales grid, and making commentary for the addendum.

4. Ideally, you have experience managing other appraisal report writers.



If you don't have experience in writing commentary or the addendum, or do not have experience with making adjustments on the sales grid, we would still like to hear from you as we have a different job that would fit your experience better.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: Media Operations & Production Support
description:
About the Company

Summer House Media Co. is a growing media company focused on creating and distributing positive, purpose-driven content across digital and print platforms.



The company is launching with two initial projects: a YouTube channel and an EDDM direct mail advertising program that helps small businesses and entrepreneurs reach local households through postcard advertising. Over time, the company plans to expand into additional media projects, including podcasts, books, social media channels,
 campaigns, digital products, branded content, and other creative initiatives.



Role Overview

We are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Virtual Assistant to support both the YouTube and EDDM projects. This role will help manage timelines, organize assets, support production workflows, document processes, and keep both projects moving forward.



This is a dynamic role for someone who enjoys variety, structure, media, marketing, and operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, tech-savvy, resourceful, and comfortable supporting both creative and administrative tasks.



As Summer House Media Co. grows, there may be opportunities for this role to expand into larger responsibilities across media operations, production coordination, project management, and future media initiatives.



Key Responsibilities

The VA may support:

* YouTube channel setup, content planning, production tracking, upload preparation, and performance tracking

* Research for video ideas, keywords, titles, thumbnails, descriptions, and trends

* Organization of scripts, footage, thumbnails, captions, creative assets, and publishing materials

* EDDM campaign coordination from sales handoff through design, proofing, print submission, and mailing support

* Collection and organization of advertiser information, logos, offers, and creative assets

* Follow-up with advertisers, vendors, designers, editors, printers, or contractors as needed

* Maintenance of project trackers, calendars, checklists, folders, and deadlines

* Creation and updating of SOPs, templates, training documents, and repeatable workflows

* Quality control reviews to ensure details are accurate before publishing, printing, or distribution

* Weekly status updates that summarize progress, priorities, risks, delays, and next steps

* General administrative and operations support related to current and future media projects



Ideal Candidate

The best fit for this role is someone who is:

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable managing multiple projects at once

* Strong with follow-up, deadlines, and communication

* Tech-savvy and willing to learn new tools

* Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented

* Comfortable working in a startup-style environment

* Able to create order from ambiguity

* Reliable, responsive, and consistent

* Interested in media, content creation, marketing, advertising, or operations

* Excited about learning, skill development, and growing with the company



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Virtual assistant or operations support

* YouTube channel or content production support

* Social media or digital content coordination

* Project management

* Direct mail, print production, or advertising coordination

* Working with freelancers, designers, editors, printers, or vendors

* SOP creation, documentation, and process improvement

* Tools such as Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Canva, YouTube Studio, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, 
, or similar platforms



Prior experience with every tool is not required, but the candidate should be comfortable learning new systems quickly.



Expectations

The VA will be expected to:

* Keep tasks, files, and deadlines clearly organized

* Provide timely updates and communicate delays early

* Take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish

* Follow established processes while helping improve them

* Ask thoughtful questions when direction is unclear

* Maintain confidentiality around company projects, vendors, campaign details, and business plans

* Balance both project areas based on weekly priorities

* Help build repeatable systems as the company grows



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means both administration and projects are organized, deadlines are tracked, assets are easy to find, communication is clear, and production workflows are documented. The VA will help reduce founder workload, keep projects moving, and support the company’s growth into future media initiatives.



Application Instructions

To apply, please submit:



1. A brief introduction about your experience

2. Examples of projects you have supported related to content, YouTube, print production, advertising, or operations

3. Tools and platforms you are comfortable using

4. Your availability and preferred working hours

5. Your hourly rate or project-based pricing

6. A short explanation of how you would stay organized while supporting two different media projects at once

7. Any media projects or skills you are most interested in learning or supporting in the future



Strong Fit Statement

This role is ideal for a VA who enjoys variety, structure, and execution. You will help build two early-stage media projects from the ground up while creating systems that can support future growth. The right candidate will bring organization, follow-through, and initiative, with the opportunity to grow alongside Summer House Media Co. as new media projects are introduced.

maintaining accurate records in the company's CRM system.

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager (ClickUp Setup from Scratch | SOPs | KPIs | 3+ Years)
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.

You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented --and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.

Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly,  without the founders being involved in every daily decision.

If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems, keep reading.



What You'll Do:

- Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

- Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

- Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly

- Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

- Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

- Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

- Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

- Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

- Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

- Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

- Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

- Keep an eye on profitability alongside the founders

- Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Tools You Must Know:

- ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

- Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

- Slack or similar - team communication

- Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

- Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



- 3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

- You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

- You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

- You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

- You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

- Excellent English, written and verbal

- Familiarity with Amazon tools

- You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup: 

- $1,200–$1,600+/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

- Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

- Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

- Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision



To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) — what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do — describe what you actually did.

3. You join BTS Brands on Monday. By Friday you need to send the founders your first weekly summary. What's in it and how did you get that information in 5 days?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?

• Search Intent: Always figure out why a user is searching. Provide the most direct, valuable answer to their query.

• Keywords: Use tools like Google Keyword Planner to find phrases people are typing, then integrate them naturally into your titles, headings, and body.

• Metadata: Write catchy SEO Titles (under 60 characters) and Meta Descriptions (under 160 characters) to boost your click-through rates. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

2. Technical SEO (Site Health)

• Speed & Mobile-Friendliness: Ensure your site loads quickly and functions flawlessly on mobile devices.

• Crawlability: Make it easy for search engine "spiders" to read your website by submitting a clean XML sitemap. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

3. Off-Page SEO (Authority)

• Backlinks: Focus on getting other high-authority, trustworthy websites to link to your content. This tells search engines your site is a credible source. [1]

4. Generative/Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

• AI Search: Optimize your site to be cited by AI systems like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini. Write clearly, cite your own sources, and structure content with clear headings and bullet points

title: Amazon PPC Growth Lead
description:
READ THIS FIRST:

Please fill out this Google Form to be considered for this job:





Amazon PPC Growth Lead



About the Role

We are hiring an Amazon PPC Growth Lead to own advertising strategy and performance across a portfolio of Amazon brands.

This is not a maintenance role. 

We are not looking for someone who simply adjusts bids, checks budgets, and waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of PPC as a growth function inside the business.

If you are used to brand managers specifically telling you which products to raise budgets on and by how much, this is not the role for you. 

You will analyze the performance, know the brands inside and out, talk to the clients directly, collaborate with the brand manager on joint strategy, and advise on the strategy necessary to drive the growth.

The right person knows how to analyze performance, identify what matters, create a plan, and communicate clearly with clients. They understand that Amazon advertising is not just about ACoS. It is about revenue, profitability, ranking, product growth, budget allocation, conversion, and total business performance.

You should be the person who sees what is happening before the client asks. You bring ideas. You find problems. You recommend action. You follow through.

Clients should feel confident that you understand their business and are actively leading the advertising strategy forward.

You must be comfortable organizing and presenting data and analysis to the client, explaining your analysis and decision making and talking for a 1 hour PPC meeting 4-5 times per week.

We are building a growth oriented agency with the longer term goal of launching our own products. 



What You’ll Own

You will own PPC strategy and performance for assigned Amazon accounts.

That means you will:

Build and manage Amazon PPC strategies that support client growth goals

Analyze performance across campaigns, products, keywords, search terms, budgets, and profitability

Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve efficiency, reduce waste, and scale what is working

Explain what is happening in the account, why it is happening, and what should happen next

Bring proactive recommendations to clients and internal teams

Create action plans for underperforming areas and follow through until there is a result

Connect PPC performance to broader business drivers like conversion rate, pricing, inventory, reviews, organic rank, margin, and product lifecycle

Communicate strategy clearly so clients trust that their business is being actively managed

Stay current on Amazon Ads changes, new opportunities, testing strategies, and competitive shifts



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by whether you “touched” campaigns or adjusted bids.

Success is measured by whether you are helping move the client’s business forward.

You are successful when:

Clients feel confident that PPC is being owned, not maintained

You bring smart recommendations before being asked

You can clearly explain performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps

Accounts become stronger, cleaner, more strategic, and more scalable under your ownership

PPC decisions are tied to business outcomes, not just campaign metrics

You identify problems early and come with solutions

You know when to push for growth, when to protect profitability, and when to challenge the current strategy

Your work creates visible impact on revenue, profitability, efficiency, or client confidence



What We Do Not Want

This role is not a fit for someone who:

Is used to spending most of your time raising and lowering bids

Waits to be told what to do

Runs mostly auto and category campaigns

Reports high level aggregated numbers without diving into the details and explaining what they mean

Thinks ACoS is the only metric that matters

Avoids accountability for business outcomes

Needs someone else to create the strategy

Does the minimum required campaign work and calls it optimization

Uses AI or Automation to do the majority of the work.

We need someone who thinks, owns, communicates, and drives.



Responsibilities

Own Amazon PPC strategy across assigned client accounts

Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns

Analyze account performance and identify growth, efficiency, and profitability opportunities

Build campaign structures that support scale, control, and clear decision-making

Manage keyword strategy, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, budgets, and bid strategy

Develop testing plans for new campaigns, products, keywords, placements, creative, and budget strategies

Review performance trends and create clear action plans

Prepare client-facing insights, recommendations, and strategic updates

Partner with account managers and leadership to align PPC strategy with client business goals

Identify when non-PPC issues are impacting performance, including pricing, inventory, reviews, conversion rate, content, or competition

Communicate risks and opportunities early, with recommended next steps

Must be highly competent managing accounts with over $100k/mo advertising budgets.



Goals for This Role

The goal of this role is simple:

Make clients trust that their Amazon advertising is being actively led by someone who understands the business.

You will be expected to:

Drive profitable growth where opportunity exists

Improve inefficient or underperforming accounts

Build client trust through clear strategic communication

Create proactive recommendations that lead to action

Make PPC strategy easier for clients and internal teams to understand

Turn data into decisions

Own outcomes, not just tasks



Requirements

3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience

Must be able to run accounts manually.

Must also be familiar with Pacvue

Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display

Deep knowledge of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC, CTR, keyword strategy, campaign structure, and profitability

Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations

Strong communication skills, especially when explaining performance and strategy

Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or brands

Ability to work independently and take ownership without constant direction

Strong judgment around growth, efficiency, budget allocation, and profitability tradeoffs



Preferred Experience

Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment

Experience with Amazon reporting tools, PPC software, or business intelligence dashboards

Experience presenting strategy directly to clients or senior stakeholders

Understanding of Amazon SEO, product launches, ranking strategy, promotions, and catalog performance



Who Will Thrive Here

You will thrive in this role if you are used to driving a business forward with ad strategies. You are analytical, creative, and accountable. 

You like digging into accounts and figuring out what is really going on. You are not satisfied with surface-level reporting. You want to know what is working, what is broken, where the opportunity is, and what should happen next.

You do not need to be micromanaged. You want ownership. You want to be trusted. You want your recommendations to matter.

Most importantly, you understand that great PPC management is not maintenance.

It is leadership.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
ROLE DESCRIPTION: Salesforce Administrator

Department: Customer Success

Reports to: Head of Customer Success 



Role Purpose: 

The purpose of this role is to enhance how Visualcare uses Salesforce across the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams. Partnering closely with these teams, this role assesses how each function uses the platform day-to-day, identifies opportunities to improve workflows, and designs and builds the automations, dashboards, and data structures needed to support efficient, data-driven operations. This role plays an important part in ensuring Salesforce is well configured, well used, and trusted as the single source of truth for customer, lead, and account information at Visualcare, and works with leadership across Sales and Customer Success to ensure platform investment translates into measurable business outcomes.



What are the requirements/credentials of an ideal candidate

• 4+ years working hands-on with Salesforce in a configuration, administration, or build capacity, ideally within a SaaS or technology-driven environment

• Demonstrated experience customising Salesforce — including building flows, process automations, validation rules, page layouts, custom objects, and approval processes

• Strong skills in designing and building dashboards and reports that support day-to-day operations and leadership decision-making across multiple business functions

• Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and/or Customer Support teams to understand their workflows and translate operational needs into well-scoped Salesforce solutions

• Proven experience managing data quality in Salesforce — including data audits, deduplication, cleansing, and lead/contact enrichment

• Salesforce Administrator certification - Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Platform App Builder certifications highly regarded

• Systems thinker with a strong workflow orientation — able to map how work flows across people, processes, and tools, and design solutions that hold up at scale

• High attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and change management

• Excellent communication skills — able to partner with non-technical stakeholders, understand their workflows, and translate requirements into clear technical solutions

• Comfortable working across competing priorities from multiple business functions, with the ability to triage and sequence work transparently



?

Key Areas of Focus: 

* Workflow Discovery & Solution Design (30%)

-Partner with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams to understand how each function uses Salesforce on a day-to-day basis.

-Identify workflow inefficiencies, operational gaps, and opportunities for process improvement across teams.

Recommend practical and scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and priorities.

Document both current-state and future-state workflows clearly for stakeholder alignment and ongoing business reference.



*Salesforce Configuration & Automation (35%)

-Build and configure Salesforce solutions including flows, automations, validation rules, custom objects, and page layouts.

Implement workflow enhancements that reduce manual processes and improve operational efficiency across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk functions.



-Apply structured testing and change management processes to ensure system stability and user adoption.

Maintain clear technical documentation for all configurations, automations, and system enhancements.



* Reporting & Dashboards (20%)

- Design and develop dashboards and reports that provide visibility into operational and team performance.

-Translate business and operational requirements into actionable reporting solutions such as pipeline tracking, customer health monitoring, ticket volume analysis, and resolution metrics.

-Ensure Salesforce data is properly structured to support accurate and meaningful reporting.

-Continuously optimize dashboards and reports based on evolving business priorities and KPIs.



*Data Cleansing & Enrichment (15%)

-Conduct regular Salesforce data audits to identify duplicates, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.

-Lead ongoing data cleansing initiatives to maintain Salesforce as a reliable source of truth.

-Enrich customer and lead records with relevant supporting data to improve targeting, segmentation, and reporting accuracy.

-Establish and maintain data quality standards, naming conventions, and governance processes to ensure long-term data integrity.



?

Success measures

• Salesforce workflows across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk are continuously improved, with regular delivery of scoped, well-tested enhancements

• Dashboards and reports are actively used by each business function and leadership for day-to-day decision-making

• Measurable improvements in operational efficiency (e.g. reduction in manual handling, improved resolution times, improved pipeline visibility) against baselines agreed with each team

• Salesforce data quality is consistently maintained — duplicates, gaps, and stale records reduced over time against agreed standards

• Customer and lead records are appropriately enriched to support segmentation, targeting, and reporting

• Strong, trusted working partnerships with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams, with clear and transparent prioritisation of competing requests

title: Shopify Developer & Systems Specialist (eCommerce, Integrations & AI Automation)
description:
About us

Waxit International is an Australian eCommerce business operating across multiple Shopify stores and brands. We've been in online retail for close to 15 years and have built a solid operational foundation - now we're investing in making our systems, integrations and technology work smarter. We're looking for the right person to help us audit, improve and manage what we've built, and help shape what comes next.



The Role:

You'll start with a comprehensive audit of our Shopify stores and the systems that connect them - integrations, custom apps, automations, and more. Once that's done, you'll shift into an ongoing part-time management and improvement role, with real scope to grow as we build out new systems and capabilities.



This isn't a task-taker role. We want someone who can look at how things are connected, spot what's broken or inefficient, and tell us honestly what needs fixing - then do the fixing. We're also beginning to invest seriously in AI-assisted systems and automation, and this role will play a central part in that as it develops & can be a key component to further growth.



What You'll Be Doing

- Conduct a thorough audit of our Shopify stores - theme, custom scripts, apps, B2B wholesale functionality, and overall site health

- Audit and document our systems stack - including integrations between Shopify, Cin7 (Dear Inventory), StarShipIT, and Xero

- Review and assess our custom-built apps hosted on Vercel, identifying issues, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities

- Build, manage and improve automation workflows using tools like Make, Zapier, and Notion

- Assist in the development and implementation of AI-assisted systems (including Claude and related tools) to improve business operations

- Maintain and manage ongoing system health, integrations, and Shopify store functionality on a part-time basis post-audit

- Document everything - we want clean, accessible records of how our systems work and how to manage them

- Proactively identify opportunities to improve how our stores and systems operate, and bring ideas to the table

- Rectify issues uncovered during the audit - fixing, rebuilding or replacing where needed



Must Have:

- Solid Shopify development experience - Liquid templating, custom scripts, theme customisation, app integrations

- JavaScript/Node.js experience (our custom apps are Vercel-hosted)

- Experience working with third-party integrations and APIs - connecting platforms via webhooks, REST APIs, and middleware tools

- Hands-on experience with automation platforms - Make (Integromat) and/or Zapier

- Strong documentation habits - you write things down clearly and keep records others can follow

- Excellent written and spoken English - you'll be on calls with us regularly

- A systematic, methodical mindset - someone who can audit a complex setup and give us an honest picture of what they find

- Self-directed - you can work through a problem independently without hand-holding



Nice To Have:

- Experience with Cin7 Core (Dear Inventory), StarShipIT, or Xero integrations

- Familiarity with AI tools and APIs - Claude, ChatGPT, or similar

- Notion workspace setup and management experience

- Experience with Vercel deployments and Next.js

- Prior experience conducting technical audits of eCommerce stores

- Experience working across multiple Shopify stores simultaneously



The details

- Part-time ongoing role, with an initial full-time audit phase (approximately 2-3 weeks)

- Long-term, stable engagement with genuine opportunity to grow into a bigger role

- Some overlap with Australian business hours preferred (a few hours per day)



Pay: AUD $11.50–$17.25/hour (~USD $7.44–$11.16/hour) depending on experience

- Initial full-time phase (approximately 2 weeks at 40hrs/week)

- Ongoing part-time phase (approximately 3 days / 24 hours per week)



Engagement structure - we're open to either

We're flexible on how we engage you, depending on what works best for you:

- Employer of Record option - full-time employment through a registered Philippine EOR, with all statutory benefits (13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, paid leave)

- Independent contractor option - if you have an established freelance practice and prefer to invoice us directly, we're open to that. Paid via EasyPay.



Let us know in your application which you'd prefer and why.



How to apply

Please reply with:



A short intro about you and why this role interests you

- 2–3 specific examples of technical work you've done - include the platforms involved, your role, what you did, and the outcome

- Your hourly rate expectation in AUD

- Your preferred engagement structure (EOR or contractor)

- Start your application with the word "Pineapple" so we know you've actually read this ad



We read every application personally.

title: Veterinary Industry Research & Content Manager (Remote)
description:
# Veterinary Industry Research & Content Manager (Remote)



### Help Build the Most Trusted Educational Resource for Veterinarians in Canada



We are a Canadian company serving veterinary clinics across Canada. Our mission is to help veterinarians make smarter equipment and practice investment decisions through education, expertise, and trusted advice.



We're looking for a highly curious researcher and strong writer who can become an expert in the veterinary industry and turn that knowledge into content that drives business growth.



This is not a generic content writing role.



You will be responsible for researching the veterinary industry, understanding how clinic owners make decisions, interviewing subject matter experts, and creating content that helps veterinarians solve important business and equipment challenges.



If you love learning, interviewing experts, writing educational content, and using AI tools to accelerate your work, we'd like to hear from you.



---



## What You'll Do



### Industry Research



Become an expert in:



* Veterinary clinic startups

* Practice ownership

* Equipment financing

* Veterinary technology

* Clinic operations

* Industry trends



Research:



* Industry publications

* Veterinary associations

* Competitors

* Market trends

* Customer challenges



Turn research into actionable insights and content opportunities.



---



### Interview Subject Matter Experts



Conduct interviews with:



* Veterinarians

* Practice owners

* Equipment specialists

* Internal experts

* Industry partners



Extract valuable insights and transform them into educational content.



---



### Create High-Value Content



Develop:



* Educational articles

* Buying guides

* Comparison guides

* Case studies

* White papers

* Checklists

* Webinar materials

* Research reports

* Sales enablement resources



Examples of topics:



* How to finance a new veterinary clinic

* How much does digital radiography cost?

* Starting a veterinary practice in Canada

* Veterinary equipment budgeting

* Ultrasound buying guides

* Improving clinic workflow



---



### Manage Content Strategy



Own:



* Editorial calendar

* Topic research

* Content roadmap

* Content updates

* Content performance analysis



Help us become the most trusted source of information in our industry.



---



### Leverage AI Tools



Use tools such as:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Perplexity

* Gemini



to accelerate research, outlining, drafting, and content improvement.



We value thoughtful use of AI, not AI-generated fluff.



---



## What We're Looking For



### Required



* Excellent written English

* Strong research skills

* Ability to simplify complex topics

* Experience creating professional written content

* Strong critical thinking

* Comfortable learning technical subjects

* Highly organized

* Self-managed and reliable



### Bonus Points



* B2B marketing experience

* Journalism experience

* Content marketing experience

* Healthcare experience

* Veterinary industry experience

* SEO experience

* AI tool expertise



---



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first year:



* Build a deep understanding of the veterinary industry

* Create a growing library of authoritative content

* Help increase qualified inbound leads

* Improve our visibility in search and AI platforms

* Become a trusted internal source of customer and industry insights



---



## Compensation



Please include your desired monthly salary in your application.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber and are willing to pay more for exceptional talent.



---



## Application Instructions



To apply, please submit:



### 1. Resume



### 2. Writing Samples



Send 2-3 examples of content you have written.



### 3. Video Introduction (3-5 Minutes)



Please answer:



1. Why does this role interest you?

2. Tell us about a topic you became an expert in.

3. How do you research a subject you know nothing about?

4. How are AI tools changing content creation?



### 4. Include This Phrase



At the top of your application write:



**"I enjoy turning research into insight."**



This helps us identify applicants who pay attention to details.



---



## Finalists Will Complete a Paid Assessment



Final candidates will be paid to complete a short assignment involving:



* Research

* Content planning

* Writing

* AI-assisted workflow demonstration



We believe candidates should be compensated for meaningful evaluation work.



---



### Why This Role Is Different



Most content jobs focus on producing articles.



This role focuses on becoming an industry expert whose work helps veterinarians make better decisions and helps our company become the most trusted voice in the industry.



If you are naturally curious, love learning, and enjoy turning complex information into practical guidance, this could be an excellent fit.

title: Crane Draftsman VA
description:
About Premier Cranes & Rigging



Premier Cranes & Rigging is one of Victoria's leading crane hire and lifting companies, supporting major construction, infrastructure, industrial, and logistics projects throughout Australia.

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Crane Draftsman VA to join our Engineering team and assist with lift planning, crane setup drawings, technical documentation, and project support activities.

This is a full-time remote position working directly with on-site engineers, project managers, and crane operations personnel.



Key Responsibilities



Lift Planning & Drafting

Prepare crane lift plans and setup drawings.

Produce crane positioning layouts and site sketches.

Develop rigging layouts and lifting arrangements.

Update and revise drawings based on engineer feedback.

Assist with lift study preparation and documentation.



Technical Documentation

Maintain drawing registers and project documentation.

Review project information and site requirements.

Prepare supporting engineering documentation.

Ensure drawings are organised and stored according to company procedures.



Engineering Support

Support engineers with drafting and documentation requirements.

Assist with project planning activities.

Create visual layouts and technical presentations when required.

Coordinate drawing revisions and updates.



Requirements



Essential

Experience using AutoCAD or similar drafting software.

Experience creating technical drawings and plans.

Strong attention to detail.

Excellent written English communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Reliable internet connection and home office setup.



Preferred

Experience in cranes, construction, engineering, transport, mining, or heavy industry.

Understanding of crane operations and lifting activities.

Experience reading engineering or construction drawings.

Previous experience supporting engineering teams remotely.



What We Offer

Full-time remote work.

Long-term career opportunity.

Australian-based company and team.

Exposure to large-scale crane and construction projects.



Applicants with AutoCAD drafting experience and a strong technical mindset are encouraged to apply.
